svg.title: Graph/CSR-guided loads on the gem5 O3 datapath
svg.desc: The diagram connects an outgoing graph adjacency and its CSR/ReusePlan arrays to the O3 load datapath: Fetch, Decode, Rename, ROB, issue queue, physical register file, AGU, LSQ, L1D, load-data writeback, dependency wakeup, request-specific cache state, and in-order commit.
svg.text: Graph/CSR-guided loads on the gem5 O3 datapath
Adjacency entry 4->7 maps to internal 8->18, property 0x80000048, and LLC line 0x80000040.
Fetch -> Decode -> Rename -> IEW {issue, register read, AGU, LSQ, writeback} -> Commit
fixture row u=4 maps to internal CSR row u=8
Internal CSR row u=8 and aligned ReusePlan
I0 completes before P17 wakes I1
I0 record Request | per adjacency entry
I1 property Request + ReuseBind | per governed property load
ReuseBind = dest18 | T1 | e11/e15 | current8 | context k | sequence s
both loads retain native O3 ordering and fault behavior
I0 FlowThrough: record-miss LLC allocation only
I1 ReuseBind: matching property-line metadata only
native replay, squash, fault, and retirement rules
neither mechanism changes the loaded property value
